requirement.statement: depa-data-depa-orm-domain-runtime SHALL declare Kunun 1.0.4 and depa ORM 0.2.0 production dependencies by formal package name, compile read-only Kon model sources through the depa-orm-dsl-kon public root using only prefix NamedConf, flat Field profiles, typed Property relations and declaration-owned DataSource identity, explicitly project public compilation properties into current storage-neutral root contracts, and prove public compose/assemble/SQLite Writer/Reader operation from its own package environment; it SHALL reject old marker transport, nested Field storage, Field relations, direct datasource Conf, duplicate datasource identity, halfcode, dist, node_modules, capsule paths, casts of legacy schema, hidden symlink provenance and non-allowlisted depa ORM subpaths.

case.given: formal target versions are declared and sibling packages are available as hashed ephemeral tarballs
case.when: an isolated package smoke imports each dependency by package name
case.then: all imports SHALL resolve under the isolated consumer without capsule, sibling source-relative, workspace or global symlink paths

case.given: a read-only canonical Kon source defining a datasource, entity, flat fields and typed Property relation
case.when: compile, explicit projection, SQLite initialize, public Writer create, and public Reader query run
case.then: the created related rows SHALL be read back and registry destroy SHALL complete using only allowed exports

case.given: runtime source, model fixtures and package dependencies
case.when: the boundary and canonical-model guards scan them
case.then: old annotation authorities, legacy versions, halfcode, dist, node_modules, capsule paths, source-relative external imports and unallowlisted subpaths SHALL be absent
